name: Oma Razer
author: Gregory Lara
description: Razer mouse control for Omarchy: on-board profiles with a full Profile Settings editor, 5-stage DPI, polling up to 8000 Hz, Chroma RGB, and multi-model support

barWidget.description: Razer mouse control with live DPI, editable on-board profiles, polling rate, Chroma lighting, and bottom-button sync

schema.label: Show DPI value in the bar
schema.description: Display current numeric DPI next to the mouse icon in the bar

schema.label: Show in bar only when connected
schema.description: Hide the bar widget automatically when the Razer mouse is disconnected

schema.label: Notify on mouse connection
schema.description: Send a desktop notification whenever a Razer mouse is connected

schema.label: Interface Language
schema.description: Language for the Razer control panel ('en' for English, 'es' for Spanish, or 'auto')
